28/S0.subgoal: Explain how human-eye optics and engineered lens setups are used in VR headsets to create a perceived virtual image while forming a real image on the retina.

28/S1.subgoal: Explain how field of view, binocular vision, and stereoscopy support perception of depth and three-dimensional scenes.

28/S2.subgoal: Describe the translational and rotational degrees of freedom used to represent and perceive motion in 3D virtual environments.

28/S3.subgoal: Explain how visual perception constraints determine XR display requirements for spatial resolution, intensity, and temporal resolution or frame rates.

28/S4.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview the next lecture on auditory systems.
